mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_VOTE_M (user_sq, vote_ttl, vote_description_edt, vote_end_dt) VALUES (#{userSq}, #{voteTtl}, #{voteDescriptionEdt}, #{voteEndDt})
INSERT INTO TBL_VOTE_OPTION_S (vote_sq, vote_option_nm, vote_option_order) VALUES (#{voteSq}, #{voteOptionNm}, #{voteOptionOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT v.*, u.user_nickname FROM TBL_VOTE_M v LEFT JOIN TBL_USER_M u ON u.user_sq = v.user_sq WHERE v.vote_sq = #{voteSq}

SELECT v.vote_sq, v.vote_ttl, v.user_sq, u.user_nickname, v.vote_end_dt, v.vote_created_at_dtm, v.vote_view_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_VOTE_OPTION_S o WHERE o.vote_sq = v.vote_sq) AS option_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_VOTE_RECORD_S r WHERE r.vote_sq = v.vote_sq) AS total_vote_cnt FROM TBL_VOTE_M v LEFT JOIN TBL_USER_M u ON u.user_sq = v.user_sq WHERE v.vote_is_deleted_yn = 'N'
AND v.vote_ttl LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY v.vote_created_at_dtm ASC ORDER BY v.vote_view_cnt DESC ORDER BY v.vote_created_at_dtm DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_VOTE_M WHERE vote_is_deleted_yn = 'N'
AND vote_ttl LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
SELECT * FROM TBL_VOTE_OPTION_S WHERE vote_sq = #{voteSq} ORDER BY vote_option_order ASC

SELECT o.vote_option_sq, o.vote_option_nm, o.vote_option_order, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_VOTE_RECORD_S r WHERE r.vote_option_sq = o.vote_option_sq) AS vote_cnt FROM TBL_VOTE_OPTION_S o WHERE o.vote_sq = #{voteSq} ORDER BY o.vote_option_order ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_VOTE_RECORD_S WHERE vote_sq = #{voteSq}
SELECT vote_option_sq FROM TBL_VOTE_RECORD_S WHERE vote_sq = #{voteSq} AND user_sq = #{userSq}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM TBL_VOTE_OPTION_S WHERE vote_option_sq = #{voteOptionSq} AND vote_sq = #{voteSq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_VOTE_RECORD_S (vote_sq, vote_option_sq, user_sq) VALUES (#{voteSq}, #{voteOptionSq}, #{userSq})
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_VOTE_M SET vote_view_cnt = vote_view_cnt + 1 WHERE vote_sq = #{voteSq}
UPDATE TBL_VOTE_M SET vote_is_deleted_yn = 'Y' WHERE vote_sq = #{voteSq} AND user_sq = #{userSq}
